definitions.explanation: The practice of hanging washed laundry to dry inside the house rather than outdoors, common during the rainy season, in winter, or when pollen and privacy are concerns.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{部屋干|へやぼ}しをする。
examples.english: On rainy days I dry the laundry indoors.

examples.japanese: {部屋干|へやぼ}しだと{生乾|なまがわ}きの{臭|にお}いがすることがある。
examples.english: Drying indoors can sometimes leave a musty, half-dry smell.

examples.japanese: {花粉|かふん}の{季節|きせつ}は{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{部屋干|へやぼ}しする{家庭|かてい}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: During pollen season, many households dry their laundry indoors.

notes:
Composed of {部屋|へや} (room) + {干|ぼ}し (drying, from {干|ほ}す). The {ほ} becomes {ぼ} through rendaku. Can also be used with する ({部屋干|へやぼ}しする).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部屋干|へやぼ}しの{臭|にお}い: the smell of indoor-dried laundry
- {部屋干|へやぼ}し{用|よう}{洗剤|せんざい}: detergent made for indoor drying

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外干|そとぼ}し: drying outdoors — the natural opposite
- {陰干|かげぼ}し: drying in the shade — avoiding direct sunlight
